content.text:
Finding submitted.

**T4C — deviation (high).** Article IV locks us into a 36-month Initial Period, and no clause anywhere in the Agreement lets Licensee exit without cause; the only termination rights are Licensor's cause-based ones (breach, insolvency, wind-up/change of control), and there is no refund mechanic. That is walk-away territory under the playbook and fails the fallback (no 60–90 day Customer exit).

**Cure (preferred level, one insertion after Article IV):** new clause IV giving Licensee convenience termination on 30 days' written notice with a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees, plus express confirmation that Licensor has no convenience right during the Initial Period or any renewal term. Licensor's unilateral 7-year renewal option was left for the RENEWAL rule and not double-flagged here.
